description: As the "breadbasket" of Skyrim, food and common clothing are abundant.
High markup for the Cloud District nobles; ores must be imported.
Whiterun is the center of Skyrim’s farming. Massive supply. Merchants sell cheap but will barely pay for more.
Plains flora like Lavender and Tundra Cotton grow everywhere in Whiterun; very low resale value here.
Whiterun's local farms provide a constant flow of livestock products like beef, hides, and leather.
Whiterun is the 'Forge of Skyrim.' Common utility gear and iron/steel items are easy to find and mass-produced.
Home of the Honningbrew Meadery. Buying local brews is cheap, but selling them here is pointless.
High demand for luxury items in the Cloud District. Merchants charge a lot and pay well to restock fine apparel.
Essential spices and salts come from the coast or caravans, driving up prices in this inland hub.
Dwemer scrap is not local to Whiterun and must be imported from the Reach or the Rift.
